verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred hierarchy and brand intact, but it is basically the banner pasted into a square. The block sits high, leaving about 270px of dead orange below the CTA against about 190px above, so the layout feels top-heavy and unplanned. B does rearrange for the square, but the headline is so big that it crowds out everything else. The subcopy is squeezed into a centre-aligned 3-line rag ending in the fragment 'four flavours.', and it sits awkwardly beside the CTA in a bottom row whose edges (about 95px and 698px) don't line up with the headline column. That bottom row is cramped and looks off-grid.
